The strongest root-cause signal is **productcatalogservice** beginning at 23:49: disk I/O jumps from 0 to roughly 3.2–8.3 billion, alongside sharp increases in CPU, memory, and open sockets. Its p90 latency also rises from 0.0 to 0.1. Frontend latency rises in the same period, and checkoutservice and recommendationservice p90s rise as well; both depend on productcatalogservice, while frontend calls it directly. This points to a disk-related problem in productcatalogservice propagating to user-facing requests.

The telemetry does not include disk capacity/latency thresholds or populated error-log counts, so it supports a disk-related cause but does not establish the specific underlying disk failure.
